station.name: Columbia River at The Dalles, OR
station.sources: USGS NWIS 14105700 · weather DLS · The Dalles Muni (IEM / NOAA GHCN-Daily)

columnSources.tmax_c: IEM / NOAA GHCN-Daily · DLS · The Dalles Muni · max temp (°F → °C)
columnSources.tmin_c: IEM / NOAA GHCN-Daily · DLS · The Dalles Muni · min temp (°F → °C)
columnSources.precip_mm: IEM / NOAA GHCN-Daily · DLS · The Dalles Muni · precip (in → mm, trace = 0)

rating.source: Stage-discharge fit from USGS field measurements, supplied with the original HydroTwin reference material (fit_rating.py ratings.json); estimated gauge height, not a verified current USGS rating.

verticalReference.reason: Station-specific fit; gauge and terrain vertical datum alignment unverified; no inundation or absolute-elevation claim.

nrcs.source: NRCS AWDB daily soil and SNOTEL readings from the HydroTwin 25-year fetch (data25/raw_cache); soil sensor readings are regional inputs, not measurements at the river gauge.

sources.forecasts: HydroTwin 25-year build forecasts (forecasts_neural/gcn/classical), issued daily after the 29-day input window; values rounded to whole cfs.
sources.weather: USGS NWIS 14105700 · weather DLS · The Dalles Muni (IEM / NOAA GHCN-Daily)
